dialogues.jp:
ちょっとばかり商店街をうろついていると、買
い物の途中だった環に出会った。
dialogues.en:
Lotering around the shopping district earlier, I had bumped
into Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
Lotering around the shopping district earlier, I had bumped
into Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、環の買い物を手伝ってやることにして、
荷物持ちをしたりしながら、神社へ戻って来た。
dialogues.en:
I ended up helping her on her shopping, and carrying her
bags. We were heading back to the shrine.
dialogues.text:
I ended up helping her on her shopping, and carrying her
bags. We were heading back to the shrine.

dialogues.jp:
石段を全部登りきって荷物を下ろすと、環がペ
コリと頭を下げた。
dialogues.en:
After we finished climbing up the entire flight of stairs,
Tamaki bowed courteously to me.
dialogues.text:
After we finished climbing up the entire flight of stairs,
Tamaki bowed courteously to me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当にありがとうございました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you so much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you so much."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくしの買い物に付き合ってもらった上に、
　荷物まで運んでいただいて……」
dialogues.en:
"Not only for accompanying me while shopping, but for
carrying all the bags as well..."
dialogues.text:
"Not only for accompanying me while shopping, but for
carrying all the bags as well..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ま、困ったときはお互い様だからな。気にす
　るなよ」
dialogues.en:
"You'd help me out if I needed it, too. Don't worry about
it."
dialogues.text:
"You'd help me out if I needed it, too. Don't worry about
it."

dialogues.jp: ふぅ……と息を吐く。
dialogues.en: I managed to get that out in between deep breaths of air.
dialogues.text: I managed to get that out in between deep breaths of air.

dialogues.jp:
荷物を持って歩いただけなのに、けっこうな運
動量になった。
dialogues.en:
Holding all these bags, and walking up that many steps to
the shrine, is no mean feat.
dialogues.text:
Holding all these bags, and walking up that many steps to
the shrine, is no mean feat.

dialogues.jp:
それほど乱れてはいなかったが、呼吸を整える
ために深呼吸していると、着物を着た小さな少
女の一団が視界の隅に入る。
dialogues.en:
Taking one final deep breath, I spied a group of small
kimono-clad girls from the corner of my eye.
dialogues.text:
Taking one final deep breath, I spied a group of small
kimono-clad girls from the corner of my eye.

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
見ると、少女の親と思われる大人達と、写真を
撮っていた。
dialogues.en:
A bunch of adults near them were taking pictures of the Miko
litter. Seems like they're the parents of the bunch.
dialogues.text:
A bunch of adults near them were taking pictures of the Miko
litter. Seems like they're the parents of the bunch.

dialogues.jp:
少女達ははしゃぎながら、時々親に甘えたりし
ている。
dialogues.en:
The girls were in high spirits, constantly fussed over by
their parents.
dialogues.text:
The girls were in high spirits, constantly fussed over by
their parents.

dialogues.jp:
俺の視線に気づいたのだろう。環も少女達を見
た。
dialogues.en:
I sneaked a peek beside me; Tamaki was watching the girls as
well.
dialogues.text:
I sneaked a peek beside me; Tamaki was watching the girls as
well.

dialogues.jp: その横顔を見て。
dialogues.en: I kept my gaze on the girl beside me.
dialogues.text: I kept my gaze on the girl beside me.

dialogues.jp: 環は、どんな女の子だったんだろう……。
dialogues.en: I wonder what kind of kid she was when she was young...
dialogues.text: I wonder what kind of kid she was when she was young...

dialogues.jp: そんな考えが頭をよぎる。
dialogues.en: Thoughts like that flitted past my head.
dialogues.text: Thoughts like that flitted past my head.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今日は雛祭りなんですよね」
dialogues.en: "Ah yes, today is the Girl's Festival."
dialogues.text: "Ah yes, today is the Girl's Festival."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あの女の子達です」
dialogues.en: "Those children, I mean."
dialogues.text: "Those children, I mean."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そうか」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, I see."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, I see."

dialogues.jp:
拝殿の脇に小さな雛人形が飾ってあるのが目に
入った。
dialogues.en:
The little doll hanging by the side of the front gate
should've clued me in...
dialogues.text:
The little doll hanging by the side of the front gate
should've clued me in...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「買い物で少し手間取ってしまいましたからこ
　れから急いでその支度をしないと。参拝者の
　方に甘酒を用意することになってますので」
dialogues.en:
"I'd spent more time shopping than I expected... I will have
to hurry to ready the preprations."
dialogues.text:
"I'd spent more time shopping than I expected... I will have
to hurry to ready the preprations."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……ということは、環は今日、裏方として働
　くのか」
dialogues.en: "...So, for today, you're a stage hand?"
dialogues.text: "...So, for today, you're a stage hand?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「はい。今日の主役は、あくまでも小さな女の
　子ですから」
dialogues.en: "Yes, the main attraction for today, are these children."
dialogues.text: "Yes, the main attraction for today, are these children."

dialogues.jp: そう言って環が微笑んだ。
dialogues.en: She smiled as she spoke.
dialogues.text: She smiled as she spoke.

dialogues.jp:
ま、確かに雛祭りという歳でもないのかもしれ
んが。
dialogues.en: I suppose age isn't a factor at all during festivals.
dialogues.text: I suppose age isn't a factor at all during festivals.

dialogues.jp: せっかく女の子のお祝いな訳だしな。
dialogues.en:
Even kids can offer their blessings for the Girl's Festival
too...
dialogues.text:
Even kids can offer their blessings for the Girl's Festival
too...

dialogues.jp: 「よし」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: ここは一つ、サービスするか。
dialogues.en: I can do a little something for her, at least.
dialogues.text: I can do a little something for her, at least.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「手を出せ」
dialogues.en: "Hold out your hands."
dialogues.text: "Hold out your hands."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Okay..."
dialogues.text: "Okay..."

dialogues.jp:
訳が分からないと言った感じで小首を傾げなが
らも、環が両手を差し出した。
dialogues.en:
With the confusion clear on her face and tilted head, she
held out both her hands to me.
dialogues.text:
With the confusion clear on her face and tilted head, she
held out both her hands to me.

dialogues.jp:
どこか小動物めいた仕草に微笑みを漏らしなが
ら、俺はピンク色の桃の形をイメージする。
dialogues.en:
With the image of the gaggle of little animals fresh in my
head, I visualized a pink-coloured figure.
dialogues.text:
With the image of the gaggle of little animals fresh in my
head, I visualized a pink-coloured figure.

dialogues.jp: （……気持ちで味が変わる訳じゃないが……）
dialogues.en: "(...My feelings may not change the taste, but...)"
dialogues.text: "(...My feelings may not change the taste, but...)"

dialogues.jp: おいしくなるようにと、想いを込めた。
dialogues.en:
I put all my emotions into making it as delicious as
possible.
dialogues.text:
I put all my emotions into making it as delicious as
possible.

dialogues.jp:
環が差し出している手の平の上に、俺は手をか
ざして。
dialogues.en: I then placed my hand over Tamaki's outstretched hands,
dialogues.text: I then placed my hand over Tamaki's outstretched hands,

dialogues.jp: そこに、作りたての桃饅頭を乗せてやった。
dialogues.en: Leaving a pink-coloured manjuu there.
dialogues.text: Leaving a pink-coloured manjuu there.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あの……これは？」
dialogues.en: "Ah... is this?"
dialogues.text: "Ah... is this?"

dialogues.jp: 不思議そうに見つめる環に。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked at me curiously.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked at me curiously.

dialogues.jp:
「包装紙は破いちゃったけど……雛祭りのお祝
　いだ。やるよ」
dialogues.en:
"I kinda tore up the wrapping already, but... here's my gift
for the festival. Work hard, Tamaki."
dialogues.text:
"I kinda tore up the wrapping already, but... here's my gift
for the festival. Work hard, Tamaki."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わぁ……ありがとうございます！」
dialogues.en: "Wah... thank you very much!"
dialogues.text: "Wah... thank you very much!"

dialogues.jp: 嬉しそうに微笑む環。
dialogues.en: She smiled happily.
dialogues.text: She smiled happily.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様、私、嬉しいです！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama, I'm overjoyed!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama, I'm overjoyed!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
dialogues.en: "Mmhmm."
dialogues.text: "Mmhmm."

dialogues.jp: これだけ喜んでもらえれば、悪い気はしない。
dialogues.en: Seeing her this happy made me feel happy as well.
dialogues.text: Seeing her this happy made me feel happy as well.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「でも、いつの間に買ったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "But, when did you find the time to buy this?"
dialogues.text: "But, when did you find the time to buy this?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「企業秘密だ」
dialogues.en: "Trade secret."
dialogues.text: "Trade secret."

dialogues.jp:
……まさか、今ここで作ったというわけにはい
かないし。
dialogues.en: ...I can't exactly tell her that I just created it.
dialogues.text: ...I can't exactly tell her that I just created it.

dialogues.jp: 「んなこといいから、食えって」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about that, just enjoy it."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about that, just enjoy it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。では、いただきます」
dialogues.en: "Alright, then I will."
dialogues.text: "Alright, then I will."

dialogues.jp: 満面の笑みを浮かべて、環は饅頭を口にする。
dialogues.en:
With a smile enveloping her entire face, she brought the
manjuu to her open mouth.
dialogues.text:
With a smile enveloping her entire face, she brought the
manjuu to her open mouth.

dialogues.jp: 饅頭を食べるたびに深まっていく環の笑顔。
dialogues.en:
The taste of the manjuu seemed to brighten her smile even
further.
dialogues.text:
The taste of the manjuu seemed to brighten her smile even
further.

dialogues.jp:
普段、｛りん／凛｝とした雰囲気を持っている環が、すご
く幼く見える。
dialogues.en:
The usually cool, calm and collected Tamaki was now looking
very childishly happy.
dialogues.text:
The usually cool, calm and collected Tamaki was now looking
very childishly happy.

dialogues.jp:
俺まで表情が弛んでしまいそうになるのをどう
にか堪えながら。
dialogues.en:
I didn't know how to take the sudden change in her
demeanour.
dialogues.text:
I didn't know how to take the sudden change in her
demeanour.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなに、うまいか？」
dialogues.en: "Is it that good?"
dialogues.text: "Is it that good?"

dialogues.jp:
ここまで喜ばれると、はっきり言って作りがい
があるってもんだ。
dialogues.en:
The way she normally was, it couldn't have been an
exaggeration, but...
dialogues.text:
The way she normally was, it couldn't have been an
exaggeration, but...

dialogues.jp: 「もしかして、和菓子好きとか」
dialogues.en: "Do you really like sweets?"
dialogues.text: "Do you really like sweets?"

dialogues.jp: はい、と環は静かに頷いて、俺を見つめてきた。
dialogues.en: She silently nodded, while still staring at me.
dialogues.text: She silently nodded, while still staring at me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様のお菓子って、不思議な力があるみた
　いですね。なんだか、元気になれる気がしま
　す」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-sama's sweets appear to have a strange power. I
always feel energetic after eating one."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-sama's sweets appear to have a strange power. I
always feel energetic after eating one."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そ、そう言われたら、作っ……げふ、げふん、
　あげた甲斐があるってものだ」
dialogues.en:
"W, well, I did work hard in ma... ah, ahem, I'm glad the
end result was good."
dialogues.text:
"W, well, I did work hard in ma... ah, ahem, I'm glad the
end result was good."

dialogues.jp:
俺が手のやり場に困っていると、環が一層笑顔
を深めた。
dialogues.en:
At my nervous reason, Tamaki's smile grew even more
brilliant.
dialogues.text:
At my nervous reason, Tamaki's smile grew even more
brilliant.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「きっと……朝倉様の思いが……気持ちが……
　優しさが……いっぱいいっぱいつまってるん
　ですね」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-sama's thoughts... feelings... and kindness... I
can feel all of them in this wagashi."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-sama's thoughts... feelings... and kindness... I
can feel all of them in this wagashi."

dialogues.jp: ペコリと頭を下げる環。
dialogues.en: She bowed in graciousness.
dialogues.text: She bowed in graciousness.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、そんな風に言われると、照れちゃう
な。確かに、喜んでほしくて、作ったわけなん
だが。
dialogues.en:
Even though I made it to make her happy, her praise still
embarassed me...
dialogues.text:
Even though I made it to make her happy, her praise still
embarassed me...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ごちそうさまでした。わたくしは甘酒の準備
　がありますのでこれで……」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you for the meal. I must prepare the sake now,
though..."
dialogues.text:
"Thank you for the meal. I must prepare the sake now,
though..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、頑張れよ」
dialogues.en: "Right, do your best."
dialogues.text: "Right, do your best."

dialogues.jp:
環はもう一度俺に一礼すると、荷物を持って、
拝殿の方へと入っていった……。
dialogues.en:
Thanking me once again, she walked into the shrine with her
bags.
dialogues.text:
Thanking me once again, she walked into the shrine with her
bags.

dialogues.jp: 「帰るか……」
dialogues.en: "I'd head back too..."
dialogues.text: "I'd head back too..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は家路についた。
dialogues.en: I started on the road home.
dialogues.text: I started on the road home.

dialogues.jp: ◆環と桃饅頭◆
dialogues.en: ◆Tamaki And The Pink Manjuu?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Tamaki And The Pink Manjuu?◆

dialogues.jp:
環の買い物を手伝ってやり、神社へ戻ると、参
拝に来ていた女の子を見て、今日が雛祭りであ
ることを思い出す。
dialogues.en:
On the way back to the shrine from helping Tamaki with
shopping, we found a gaggle of little girls, it being the
Girl's Festival.
dialogues.text:
On the way back to the shrine from helping Tamaki with
shopping, we found a gaggle of little girls, it being the
Girl's Festival.

dialogues.jp:
俺が環に和菓子をプレゼントすると、環は嬉し
そうな顔をする。
dialogues.en:
I made a wagashi for Tamaki as a present, which made her
overjoyed.
dialogues.text:
I made a wagashi for Tamaki as a present, which made her
overjoyed.
